order_wins: **Man Industries** — discloses **new orders of approximately Rs 600 crore** for supply of various types of pipes to domestic and international customers, for delivery within six to nine months _(~10.1% of mcap)_. Its unexecuted order book, stated in the same letter at about Rs 4,100 crore, is the book and not the event.

**Anawil Wire & Engineering** — secures its **largest-ever order at Rs 133.98 crore excluding GST, Rs 140.68 crore including**, to supply 38 EN-156/3.3 MW wind turbine towers for an FDRE wind project in Andhra Pradesh, for completion by Q4 2026-27.

**Systematic Industries** — receives **Notifications of Award from Power Grid Corporation of India for the OPGW-06 package, an aggregate contract value of Rs 82.42 crore** _(~13.4% of mcap)_, to supply, execute and erect optical ground wire on transmission lines at pan-India locations. Awarded 24 August, signed 9 September.

**B.R.Goyal Infrastructure** — wins an **NHAI work order at an accepted value of Rs 52,39,77,575** _(~12.0% of mcap)_, engaging it by e-tender as user-fee collection agency at the Khambara Fee Plaza in Maharashtra for one year, with upkeep of the adjacent toilet blocks.

**Bondada Engineering** — its joint venture with BEST Infra receives a **Letter of Intent from Northern Power Distribution Company of Telangana of Rs 41,01,42,500 including taxes** _(~1.3% of mcap)_, for 12,500 single-phase and 27,500 three-phase smart meters over 11 months from the purchase order.

**Ceinsys Tech** — receives a **Rs 28,17,42,382 Letter of Award excluding GST from Rite Water Solutions (India)** _(~2.0% of mcap)_ to supply and commission station RTUs and FRTU modules giving SLDC and ALDC visibility of 125 substations of 132/110/100 kV, over 24 months of execution and 24 of warranty.

**Ameenji Rubber** — receives a **Letter of Acceptance from the Principal Chief Materials Manager, North Western Railway, Jaipur, valued at Rs 24,15,37,849** _(~9.9% of mcap)_, to manufacture and supply CGRSP over 24 months.

**Optivalue Tek Consulting** — receives a **Rs 20.70 crore order from Rchobbytech Solutions for the supply of nano drones** on 9 September _(~4.9% of mcap)_, delivered monthly against an agreed milestone schedule and completing within nine months.

**Optivalue Tek Consulting** — files a **second order three minutes later, Rs 16.25 crore from Aaroosha Technologies** for modernisation of the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation website, over approximately nine months _(~3.8% of mcap)_.

**Affordable Robotic & Automation** — receives **two turnkey purchase orders for robotic welding lines, of Rs 3,81,31,348 and Rs 6,21,05,000**, for delivery by December 2026 _(Rs 10.02 crore is our addition of the two; ~5.2% of mcap on our calculation)_. Both customers are "not disclosed due to confidentiality".

**Destiny Logistics & Infra** — receives a **work order from Steel Authority of India's IISCO Steel Plant sized Rs 6,91,22,294.10** _(~3.1% of mcap)_, to extend the WRM KL and LM bays on a delivery schedule of eighteen months.

**Skytech Infinite Platform** — receives a **purchase order of Rs 4,65,00,000 excluding GST** _(~15.3% of mcap)_ to supply, erect and commission MCC, APFC and VFD for the ReNew TopCon ETP package at Dholera, Gujarat, over roughly ten weeks, from a contractor it cannot name for confidentiality.

**NACDAC Infrastructure** — receives **purchase orders from Godrej Properties for site civil infrastructure works at Godrej DMIC, Rs 2,83,30,500 before Rs 50,99,490 of GST** _(~11.3% of mcap)_, for execution within four months.

**3i Infotech** — receives a **Rs 1,02,31,832 purchase order excluding taxes from an unnamed leading Indian commodity exchange** for 24x7 disaster-recovery and datacentre management support, spread across FY 2026-27 to FY 2028-29 _(~0.2% of mcap)_.

**Dev Information Technology** — secures an **enterprise technology order of approximately Rs 30 lakh from the Central Power Research Institute, Bangalore** to re-design, commission and maintain the CPRI bilingual website to GIGW 3.0 standards.

**Iware Supplychain Services** — wins an **NCERT contract to transport books and printing paper from NCR-Delhi to Jhansi, Varanasi and Vasai** for one year, extendable to three. Its own annexure states the aggregate value cannot be ascertained, the award letter specifying neither quantities nor trips.

**BCPL Railway Infrastructure** — declares itself **single lowest bidder (L1) on an Eastern Railway, Howrah division tender to replace isolator and drop jumpers, a project cost of Rs 5.89 crore including GST** _(~4.8% of mcap)_. Its annexure says the contract is "yet to be received" and dates execution from a Letter of Acceptance.

**Happy Square Outsourcing** — receives a **third extension of its 2023 staffing work order from Madhya Pradesh Power Transmission at Pithampur, approximately Rs 59.76 lakh inclusive of taxes** _(~1.3% of mcap)_, running 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027.
**Atmastco Limited** — Atmastco Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Patil Automation** — its board approves a **Rs 96.38 crore preferential issue of up to 20,94,000 equity shares and 18,24,000 convertible warrants, both at Rs 246** _(~14.0% of mcap)_, to Motilal Oswal Financial Services, Calliope Capital Advisors, Subhkam Ventures I and promoter Manoj Patil, subject to members' approval.

**Padam Cotton Yarns** — its board approves **raising up to Rs 27,00,00,000 by a rights issue of Re 1 shares**, with terms, entitlement ratio and record date all to be decided later and regulatory approvals outstanding. Nothing is allotted.

**Neogen Chemicals** — its Fund-Raising Committee **opens a QIP, adopting the preliminary placement document and fixing a floor price of Rs 2,189.73 a share** off the 10 September relevant date, with up to 5% discount permitted. No issue size is stated in the document.

**Capital Infra Trust** — its unitholders pass a postal ballot **authorising a preferential issue of units to sponsor Gawar Construction of up to Rs 1,24,99,92,800**, declared carried on 9 September. Nothing is yet issued, the figure is a ceiling, and the issuer is an InvIT.

**Onesource Industries and Ventures** — its board approves a rights issue of Re 1 shares for **an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs 52,45,00,000** _(~367.6% of mcap)_, with issue price, entitlement ratio and record date all still undecided — an approved ceiling, not capital raised.

**Sharika Enterprises** — receives **BSE in-principle approval for 1,51,49,079 equity shares to non-promoters and 38,38,102 convertible warrants, each of Rs 5 face value at not less than Rs 14.33**, on a preferential basis — a listing step on an issue already announced.

**Remi Edelstahl Tubulars** — receives **BSE in-principle approval for 8,33,331 equity shares and 3,97,377 warrants to WSG Co. Ltd, promoter-group Hanuman Freight and Skyrise Mercantile and three non-promoters**, an issue its 31 August AGM already approved. The letter states no issue price.

**Kalyani Cast-Tech** — receives **BSE in-principle approval for a preferential issue of 3,23,123 convertible warrants** to promoter and non-promoter categories. The letter names no allottee and states no price, so the issue has no size.

**Madhya Bharat Agro Products** — on **undersubscription by certain proposed allottees** its board cuts planned utilisation of already-raised preferential-issue proceeds from Rs 317,47,75,000 to Rs 300,48,35,000, the whole reduction falling on the Dhule plant object. No new capital is raised.
equity_allotments: **Ratnaveer Precision Engineering** — allots **1,24,99,669 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs 10 at Rs 264 each, Rs 329.99 crore**, completing its rights issue and taking paid-up capital from 7,14,26,681 to 8,39,26,350 shares. The day's largest verified figure, and an allotment, so §4 keeps it out of movers.

**Ice Make Refrigeration** — allots **23,67,573 fresh equity shares of Rs 10 at Rs 802.51 on a preferential basis to Japan's Galilei Holdings**, which takes 12.36%, with Bhumi Patel and Shweta Patel at 0.34% each. The company filed the identical outcome twice, 2m31s apart.

**Kshitij Polyline** — allots **5,98,86,887 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs 2 at Rs 3.17, Rs 1,898.41 lakh**, on a rights issue subscribed to 104.85%, taking paid-up shares from 15,42,44,874 to 21,41,31,761.

**Purple Finance** — allots **55,00,000 shares at Rs 39 to promoter Intellect Money Finvest on conversion of past warrants, the balance 75% being Rs 16,08,75,000**, and separately **27,00,000 fresh shares to Manisha Agarwal at Rs 72, Rs 19,44,00,000**. Only the second leg is new capital.

**Mukka Proteins** — allots **2,00,00,000 convertible warrants to non-promoter investors at Rs 23.50, Rs 47,00,00,000** _(~5.3% of mcap)_, on receipt of the 25% upfront of Rs 5.88 a warrant; the balance 75% falls due within 18 months, so most of the capital has not yet arrived.

**Shah Metacorp** — allots **2,75,00,000 equity shares at Rs 4.71 to promoter-director Mona Viral Shah on conversion of warrants issued in June 2025**, the balance 75% of Rs 3.5325 a warrant being Rs 9,71,43,750; paid-up capital rises to Rs 1,01,98,74,228.

**Modern Dairies** — allots **19,00,000 shares to promoter-group holders Krishan Goyal HUF, Aditya Goyal and Chandigarh Finance on conversion of warrants issued in March 2025**, against the balance Rs 37.50 a warrant, Rs 7,12,50,000; all warrants were exercised in full.
m_and_a: **MedPlus Health Services** — its board approves buying the **residual 0.01% of material subsidiary Optival Health Solutions, 17,986 equity shares of Rs 10, for cash**, taking its holding from 99.99% to 100%. The cached pages cut off before the consideration, so none is stated here; Rs 6,816.44 crore is Optival's turnover.

**Maithan Alloys** — buys **0.06% of listed ESDS Software Solution, 75,160 shares, for Rs 10.83 crore in cash** on the exchange on 9 September, a second tranche after the 0.33% for Rs 45.52 crore carried yesterday. It holds the shares as an investment with no intent to acquire control.

**7NR Retail** — allots **9,00,00,000 equity shares of Rs 10 for consideration other than cash, discharging Rs 90,00,00,000 of purchase price for 100% of Cultureantique Jewellery** at Rs 100 a CJPL share, which becomes a subsidiary. No money is raised; the acquisition is settled in stock.

**JSW Infrastructure** — **completes its IBC resolution-plan acquisition of NCR Rail Infrastructure** through step-down arm Khurja Rail Terminal, taking a Khurja private freight terminal, six rail lines and about 130 acres. The cached text stops before the consideration, so none is stated.

**Premier Energies** — wholly owned Premier Battery Technologies signs a **binding term sheet with Germany's RCT Energy India for an 85:15 joint venture to build a 12 GWh battery-storage plant at Seetharampur, Telangana**, the first 6 GWh phase expected in FY 2027-28. No investment figure is stated.

**Tankup Engineers** — signs a definitive agreement to **acquire 100% of the partnership interest in Hyderabad's Hitech Hydraulics**, an AS9100-qualified missile ground-systems and propellant-systems maker, subject to due diligence and closing. No consideration is stated in the pages cached.

**Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences** — signs a five-year exclusive Operations and Management Agreement, extendable by five, to run **Sarvottam Health Care's 183-bed Trust Hospital at Kakinada for a fee of 9% of the hospital's net revenue**.

**Devyani International** — **files a joint Competition Commission of India application with Sapphire Foods India** for the merger of Sapphire into Devyani, under the amended scheme its board approved on 26 August. Both parties filed the same application today.

**Oneindig Technologies** — signs an MoU with newly incorporated Amritdev Renewable Energy to develop a **4.8 MW PM-KUSUM Component-2 solar project at Fatehpur feeding the Gazipur substation, at Rs 13,00,000 per MW**, subject to due diligence and definitive agreements. No aggregate is stated.

**Syrma SGS Technology** — its Elemaster joint-venture company is **renamed Syrma SGS Elemaster Private Limited from 9 September** on a fresh MCA certificate, a later step on the venture agreed with Elemaster S.P.A Tecnologie Elettroniche.

**Phoenix Mills** — the NCLT-approved **merger of six step-down subsidiaries into subsidiary Astrea Real Estate Developers became effective on 10 September** when the INC-28 order filings were made. An intra-group reorganisation with no consideration.

**Indegene** — **merges Indegene Healthcare Germany GmbH into Trilogy Writing & Consulting GmbH effective 9 September**, the survivor taking the Indegene Healthcare Germany name. No cash consideration, no share exchange and no change in shareholding.

**Bharat Forge** — step-down **Bharat Forge Holding GmbH merges into wholly owned Bharat Forge Global Holding GmbH effective 25 August** to simplify the German structure, with no consideration paid and no shares issued.

**Shining Tools** — incorporates **Shinvi Tools Limited with Rs 1,00,000 of paid-up capital, subscribing 5,500 shares for Rs 55,000 to hold 55%**, the balance 45% taken by six promoter-family related parties at the same Rs 10 face value.

**CDSL** — is **allotted 9,20,00,000 equity shares of Re 1 of India International Bullion Holding IFSC for Rs 9,20,00,000** on 9 September, the second rights tranche after August's Rs 10,00,00,000, leaving its stake at 20%. Money going out to an associate, not a raise.

**Multi Commodity Exchange** — makes a **further investment of Rs 9.20 crore subscribing to Re 1 equity shares of India International Bullion Holding IFSC** through that company's rights issue, having received the requisite regulatory approvals.
capex_core: **Milky Mist Dairy Food** — commissions a **Skyr and Greek yogurt plant using ultrafiltration at Perundurai, Tamil Nadu, adding up to 150 tonnes a day for about Rs 40 crore** of internal accruals and IPO proceeds, against 20 tonnes a day of existing capacity running at full utilisation _(~0.2% of mcap)_.

**Sigma Advanced Systems** — **begins production at its Sri City aerospace facility**, shipping first precision-machined components to Sigma UK, with 75,000 sq ft live at 100,000 annual machining hours and scope to reach nearly 300,000. Rolls-Royce source-change approval is under way; no rupee figure is stated.

**Juniper Green Energy** — **commissions 35 MW of wind capacity within its 150 MW wind-solar hybrid project**, taking that project to 175 MWp of a planned 190 MWp and group operational capacity to about 2,639 MWp plus 500 MWh of storage. No contract value is stated.

**AION-TECH Solutions** — invests a **further Rs 65,00,000 of equity in wholly owned ROQIT Greenfleet Digital Solutions** at face value, taking its total investment in the pre-revenue fleet-software subsidiary to Rs 11,05,10,000. Money moving inside the group, with no change in shareholding.

**Silkflex Polymers (India)** — is **installing two 2 MT vessels to manufacture water-based inks in-house**, with commercial production subject to commissioning and trial runs and to be intimated separately. No investment figure is stated.

**KSH International** — receives **Consent to Operate from the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board for its Supa plant on 9 September, taking approved magnet winding wire capacity there to 28,800 MTPA**, valid to 31 August 2027.

**Transformers And Rectifiers (India)** — **incorporates Maxwell Grid Transformers (UK) Private Limited in the United Kingdom**, following the board approval it intimated on 27 August. No investment amount is stated.
**Danish Power Limited** — Danish Power Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
business_updates: **Results season** — 7 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Kolte-Patil Developers** — books **over 600 apartments for sales of more than Rs 600 crore in 60 hours** at the launch of Vyana at The Reserve, Vadgaon, Pune, its strongest-ever launch; the 20-acre project carries an expected Rs 4,000 crore of gross development value, which is not a booking.

**DEE Development Engineers** — reports **August order inflow of Rs 94.18 crore against Rs 87.37 crore executed, closing the month with a Rs 2,435.61 crore order book**, and cumulative FY27 inflow of Rs 972.62 crore. Its own footnote warns invoiced value differs from Ind AS 115 revenue.

**Fabtech Cleanrooms** — books **Rs 5.39 crore of orders in August, all in cleanroom partitions and none in HVAC**, split Rs 2.87 crore renewable energy and Rs 2.52 crore pharma; the order book stood at Rs 469.28 crore on 31 August.

**Orient Technologies** — signs a **USD 3.15 million three-year contract with Securonix** as its exclusive India value-added distributor, planned investment reaching about USD 5 million, with around 100 cybersecurity hires. The filing states no rupee equivalent, so none is given.

**Sterlite Technologies** — obtains **US Optical Fiber Nonconductive Plenum certification for its 48F to 576F intermittently bonded ribbon pre-terminated assemblies**, making them NFPA 262-qualified for indoor AI data-centre cabling. No order or revenue figure is given.

**Central Bank of India** — becomes the **first public sector bank to launch 'Bharat Connect for Business'** with NPCI Bharat BillPay, a B2B platform for invoicing, payments, collections and settlements, unveiled at Global Fintech Fest 2026. No financial figure is stated.

**The Ramco Cements** — its restored Pandalgudi limestone mine in Virudhunagar **becomes the first site in Peninsular India to receive Advanced Certification from The Global Biodiversity Standard**, on a 234-acre assessed area where over 430,000 native trees and shrubs have been planted since 2019.
**Inspire Films** — will **launch its Hindi fiction show 'Kyunki Papa Kehte Hain' on Sony SAB from 22 September at 7:30 pm**, also streaming on Sony LIV. No consideration or order value is stated.

**Skyways Air Services** — is **conferred a special recognition award by Emirates SkyCargo** for service quality and partnership across key trade lanes. A recognition, not a contract: no counterparty payment and no value.
distress_risk: **Reliance Communications** — the **Supreme Court dismisses the review petitions** against its 13 February 2026 judgment in Civil Appeals 4570 and 4571 of 2021, the second concerning subsidiary Reliance Telecom, finding no error apparent on the record.

**VXL Instruments** — the **NCLT Mumbai approves the resolution plan of NG Organics and Nitinbhai Govindbhai Patel** on 9 September; existing capital will be reduced and 70,00,000 new shares issued to the incoming promoters plus 3,68,421 to public shareholders.

**Shilpa Medicare** — the **NCLT Ahmedabad admits Immacule Lifesciences' Section 9 petition against wholly owned FTF Pharma over Rs 2,18,03,319 of operational debt**, ordering insolvency, a moratorium and Sunil Kumar Kedia as interim resolution professional.

**Godrej Properties** — tells NSE its Gurugram Godrej Air disputes with **Orris Infrastructure were settled by an agreement of 25 August at an estimated financial impact of about Rs 70 crore**, recorded by the Bombay High Court on 3 September.

**Viceroy Hotels** — the **Telangana High Court sets aside a Rs 3,55,99,834 cross-subsidy surcharge demand** by Southern Power Distribution Company of Telangana for FY 2005-06 to 2014-15, holding the company immune under Section 32A of the insolvency code after its completed resolution.

**ICICI Prudential Life Insurance** — the **Additional Commissioner (Mumbai Central) dismisses its GST appeal, upholding a demand of Rs 3,75,29,796** — tax of Rs 1,87,64,898 plus an equal penalty — for July 2017 to September 2019. The company will appeal further.

**Canara HSBC Life Insurance** — **IRDAI levies a penalty of Rs 1,00,00,000** by order of 10 September over policyholder-interest lapses following a mis-selling complaint raised through a social media post, and directs an action-taken report.

**Vedanta Oil and Gas** — the **Supreme Court remands SEBI's Cairn India buyback case to the Securities Appellate Tribunal for fresh adjudication** on 9 September, noting discrepancies in SEBI's trading data without upholding or rejecting the allegations.

**Shashijit Infraprojects** — receives a **GST demand-cum-show-cause notice proposing Rs 3,51,327** from the Superintendent, Central GST, Daman, for FY 2022-23 — excess input credit of Rs 93,177, late fees of Rs 15,650 and interest of Rs 2,42,500, plus penalty.

**Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy** — its US step-down subsidiary **begins fresh arbitration against OEG Inc. before a three-member American Arbitration Association panel**, pursuing counterclaims reserved in the arbitration order of 13 March 2025. No amount is stated.

**Sammaan Capital** — its **equity shareholders approve the scheme of arrangement demerging from Sammaan Finserve** at the NCLT-convened meeting, with the requisite majority under Section 230(6). The vote tallies are not in the pages cached.

**DPSC** — under insolvency since the NCLT Hyderabad order of 15 May, gives prior intimation that the **seventh committee-of-creditors meeting of India Power Corporation convenes on 11 September** to approve engagement of advocates.
**Reliance Communications** — separately convenes the **76th meeting of its committee of creditors for 11 September** under its continuing insolvency resolution process. No decision is disclosed.
**Vas Infrastructure** — its resolution professional reports that the **28th meeting of its committee of creditors was held on 9 September**. No decision or amount is disclosed.

**Raghuvansh Agrofarms** — explains to BSE its late disclosure of the **Supreme Court order of 18 August dismissing its appeals against SEBI's five-year market debarment and Rs 1,00,000 penalty**, both of which had already run their course and been paid.

**SKIL Infrastructure** — under insolvency since February 2024, has its **unaudited results for the quarter ended 30 September 2025 taken on record** by the resolution professional in place of its suspended board. The cached pages carry no figures.
other_notable: **Bizotic Commercial** — its board approves **raising funds through up to 1,36,08,000 warrants of Rs 10 face value, each convertible into one share**, to three promoter-group companies and nine non-promoters, subject to shareholders at an EGM yet to be convened. The cached pages state no issue price, so the raise has no size.

**Responsive Industries** — its **board will meet on 17 September to consider a proposal to buy back equity shares**, with the trading window closed until 48 hours after that meeting. No size or price is stated.
**SIS** — buys back **1,02,000 shares on 10 September at an average Rs 426.91** through Elara Securities, taking its open-market programme to 12,25,027 shares.
**Great Eastern Shipping** — buys back **1,75,000 shares on 10 September at an average Rs 1,400.73** through Kotak Securities, taking the total under its Rs 900 crore programme to 8,09,029 shares.
**Man Infraconstruction** — buys back **7,09,145 shares on 10 September at an average Rs 128.93** through Nirmal Bang Securities, taking its open-market programme to 12,34,145 shares.
**Advanced Enzyme Technologies** — buys back **45,410 shares on 10 September at an average Rs 303.00** through Emkay Global, taking its open-market programme to 11,88,150 shares.
**Tips Music** — buys back **38,069 shares on 10 September at an average Rs 651.79** through ITI Securities, taking its open-market programme to 38,557 shares.

**Precision Wires India** — discloses that **up to Rs 10 crore of its proposed preferential-issue proceeds is earmarked for buying land**, undertaking agricultural conversion if required and to sell the land if permission is refused. No new capital is raised by this filing.

**Coforge** — its board states that its **internal auditor's observations concern only how board-evaluation reports were circulated**, those reports having been withheld from independent directors at the Chairman's instruction, and do not touch the financial statements.

**Orient Green Power** — tells NSE surveillance it **holds no undisclosed information behind the recent volume spurt**, citing ICRA's BBB/stable ratings assigned to two subsidiaries on 8 September, the seasonality of its second quarter and capex already disclosed.
**Texmo Pipes and Products** — replies to NSE surveillance that it **holds no undisclosed price-sensitive information** and that the movement in its share price is market driven.
